title: Romantically Speaking
description: With her love life in shambles, a relationship expert (Heather Morris) receives help from her best friend (Jonathan Bennett).

title: You've Got a Friend
description: A recently orphaned boy (Dylan McLaughlin) develops an unlikely friendship with a recluse while living with his aunt and uncle.

title: Cloudy With a Chance of Love
description: Deb (Katie Leclerc), a quirky meteorologist, falls for her news producer after landing a job at a TV station.

title: Gentle Ben 2
description: With the help of Ben the black bear, Mark and his uncle try to stop a shady businessman from polluting the environment.

title: Operation Cupcake
description: A U.S. Army officer (Dean Cain) trades his uniform for an apron to help his wife (Kristy Swanson) run a bakery.

title: Friend Request
description: A woman (Erin Krakow) begins an online relationship with a famous photographer (Ryan McPartlin), not realizing that she is actually communicating with the man's young son (Ian Andrew).

title: A Time to Remember
description: Returning home for Thanksgiving, an artist (Dana Delany) learns that her estranged mother (Doris Roberts) is in the early stages of Alzheimer's disease.

title: Can't Buy My Love
description: Lilly, a hard-working EMT, is focused on her job and medical school. When wealthy slacker Jeff enters her life, she wants nothing to do with him. As she spends more time with him, she starts to realize that a book can't always be judged by its cover.

title: Decoration Day
description: Albert Sidney Finch (James Garner) is a retired judge who has lived in relative seclusion since the death of his wife. He is forced out of his isolated existence when asked to find out why a friend (Bill Cobbs) from his childhood refuses to accept a Congressional Medal of Honor for his heroic actions during World War II. While investigating, he also gets involved in the lives of his family for the first time in years, including his troubled godson Billy (Norm Skaggs).

title: The Wish List
description: A woman (Jennifer Esposito) lists the traits of her perfect man, then falls for a guy (David Sutcliffe) who meets none of the criteria.

title: Reluctant Nanny
description: Suddenly out of work, a woman takes a job as a nanny for a handsome foster father.

title: Reading, Writing & Romance
description: A struggling actor falls in love with a high-school teacher but faces the wrath of a jealous vice principal.

title: The Joneses: Unplugged
description: Two newlyweds realize their marriage may need more than financial mending during a citywide blackout.

title: Home Fires Burning
description: After his estranged son, Henry (Bill Pullman), returns a damaged man from the front lines of World War II, Jake Tibbetts (Barnard Hughes), a cantankerous Southern newspaper editor, struggles with the distance between reality and his own unreasonable expectations for his family. Tibbetts tests the patience of those closest to him -- including his wife (Sada Thompson) and his oldest friend (Robert Prosky) -- as he skirts the edges of sanity in the face of rapidly changing times.

title: The Nanny Express
description: A woman tries to heal a family from their grief when she becomes a nanny for a widower's two children.

title: Bound by a Secret
